descriptions.s9_remove_by_key_801625dc: Removes the first item whose second word equals the supplied key by replacing it with the last pointer and shrinking the range; returns success or 0x80004005.
descriptions.s9_forward_global_80166fd0: Forwards the second argument and constant size 32 to a helper operating on the small-data object at 0x804b00dc.
descriptions.s9_lookup_optional_80174074: Looks up a handle through the inner object, returning the first result word only when the helper sets its found flag.
descriptions.s9_set_record_bytes_8017df5c: Writes the two supplied bytes to offsets 25 and 24 of the indexed record.
descriptions.s9_get_record_bytes_8017df80: Reads bytes at offsets 25 and 24 of the indexed record into the supplied output pointers.
